texts.EngineUnavailable: No sandbox engine is available on this host. The HCS engine requires an elevated process: run as Administrator (or as a member of the Hyper-V Administrators group), or enable the Windows Sandbox optional feature.
texts.MultipleInstances: This engine does not allow multiple concurrent instances. Stop the running instance, or enable multi-instance support (see 'wsm multi').
texts.CheckpointNotSupported: The selected engine does not support checkpoints.
